chunks: Never does a new reminder come to them from their Lord but they listen to it with dalliance.
ai.seo_question: How do disbelievers typically respond when a new reminder from God comes to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual negligence of the disbelievers who treat divine revelation as mere entertainment rather than a solemn call to accountability. The phrase 'muḥdath' (newly revealed) underscores the continuous nature of guidance, contrasting the recipients' frivolous attitude with the gravity of the message. This behavior serves as a precursor to their ultimate failure to internalize the truth, a theme frequently discussed in tafsir works like Al-Mizan.
